objective: Talk to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

description: As you complete the tasks you're assigned in the war you'll want to talk to Vargus, the blacksmith.  Show him any badges you've earned along the way. He'll provide you with gear to match your level of commitment to our cause.
completion: Kaldon sent you? Very well, let's see what we can do for you.
